description: Intent i021 (timer-dwork-softirq-lock, snapshot s06) complete. FINDING (medium confidence): net/bridge/br_multicast.c:1115-1121, quote "void br_multicast_disable_port(struct net_bridge_port *port) { ... spin_lock(&br->multicast_lock);" — lock object br->multicast_lock (spin_lock_init at 1983) is shared between TIMER_SOFTIRQ callback bodies and process-context code with the process side missing spin_lock_bh. Timer side (all plain spin_lock, run in call_timer_fn from TIMER_SOFTIRQ): br_multicast_group_expired:248 (timer_setup at 705), br_multicast_port_group_expired:311 (timer_setup 732), br_multicast_router_expired:854 (timer_setup 1049), br_multicast_local_router_expired:882, querier_expired family:896 (timer_setup 1986/1988/1991/1993), br_multicast_port_query_expired:1003 (timer_setup 1051/1054). Process side (same lock, plain spin_lock): br_multicast_enable_port:1110 (caller br_stp.c:462 br_make_forwarding, netlink/carrier paths) and br_multicast_disable_port:1121 (caller br_stp_if.c:121 br_stp_disable_port, netlink dellink/setlink/bridge stop). Counterevidence: sibling process sites on the SAME lock already use spin_lock_bh (1073, 2036, 2055, 2070, 2177, 2227, 2240, 2274, 2318, 2337), proving mixed discipline; the receive-side plain sites (1444/1524/1603/1930/2112) run under NET_RX softirq with BH already disabled. Shape: process holder preempted by an expiring multicast timer softirq on the same CPU spins forever on multicast_lock -> soft lockup/RCU stall/DoS; untrusted trigger is remote IGMP/MLD traffic re-arming timers plus one local port-state change. Artifact validated (quote literally present at lines 1115-1121) at agent-state/findings/i021.json with 1 finding, 7 candidates, 6 limitations. UNRESOLVED candidates left for follow-up in s06: libiscsi session->frwd_lock (known vulnerable shape in sibling s05, s06 copy unverified), qdisc root_lock perturbation timers (sch_pie/sch_sfq/sch_red), cxgb4 sge.c ptp_lock timer, iwlwifi pcie/tx.c txq->lock stuck-timer. Bounded negative/limitations: finalize directive halted the whole-tree timer-callback enumeration after br_multicast; hrtimer handlers and delayed_work callbacks not separately enumerated; static analysis only (no build/lockdep/PoC, tree lacks .config); ks7010 seed present in s06 at ks7010_sdio.c:342 but excluded per the never-report-the-seed rule.
